children: VANCOUVER, BC, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wondershare today announced the launch of Wondershare PDFelement V13, the latest major release of its AI-powered PDF solution. The new version introduces
Spaces
, a knowledge workspace for learning and research, and an enhanced
Agreement Copilot

that brings agreement review, comparison, protection, and signing into a more unified workflow. Together, the new experiences extend document AI beyond answering questions toward helping users complete real-world document tasks.

This outcome-oriented approach reflects a broader shift in how people use AI. Users increasingly expect AI to understand the context of a task, work across relevant information, and support the steps needed to reach a useful result. With Wondershare PDFelement V13, this approach is applied to document-driven workflows where information needs to be understood, transformed, and acted upon.

The two workflows address distinct document-intensive scenarios. For knowledge work, Spaces helps students, educators, researchers, and other knowledge professionals turn multiple sources into structured knowledge and reusable outputs. For agreement management, Agreement Copilot brings together the capabilities users need to review, compare, protect, and sign agreements within a unified workflow.
Transforming Information into Actionable Knowledge

At the heart of Wondershare PDFelement V13's knowledge workflow is Spaces, a new knowledge workspace. By bringing PDFs, webpages, notes, and other reference materials into a single space, Wondershare PDFelement enables users to understand information across multiple sources and transform it into actionable knowledge.

For students preparing for exams, course PDFs, course notes, and lecture videos on YouTube can be brought into one Space for cross-source Q&A and transformed into summaries, quizzes, flashcards, mind maps, or podcasts—turning scattered study materials into a structured learning workflow.
Key capabilities include:
Bring related knowledge together in one Space
by organizing PDFs, YouTube URLs, text, and other reference materials around a single course, research topic, or project, creating a centralized workspace for learning and collaboration.
Understand information across multiple sources
through contextual Q&A that connects insights across documents with traceable references, helping users quickly identify key information and relationships.
Turn knowledge into reusable outputs
by generating summaries, reports, quizzes, flashcards, mind maps, and podcasts from the same collection of materials to support learning, research, and knowledge sharing.

Built around the PDF documents at the center of many learning and research workflows, Spaces lets users move directly from reading and organizing source materials to understanding and creating with them—all within Wondershare PDFelement.
Bringing End-to-End Intelligence to Agreement Workflows

Agreement Copilot brings contract review, comparison, translation, and signing into a unified workflow, helping businesses, independent professionals, and freelancers identify key terms and considerations for discussion while managing agreements more efficiently and confidently. With agreements requiring multiple steps across the document lifecycle, Agreement Copilot keeps these critical tasks within Wondershare PDFelement, allowing users to manage agreements throughout the workflow without switching between applications.
Key capabilities include:
Understand agreements with greater clarity

by reviewing contracts from the user's perspective. After identifying the user's role in the agreement—such as buyer, seller, or neutral party—Agreement Copilot highlights terms and potential areas of attention based on the user's role, while document translation helps users work with multilingual agreements more effectively.
Make informed decisions with actionable insights

by comparing different versions of agreements, identifying revisions, analyzing potential impacts, and providing contextual insights to help users identify areas that may require further review before signing.
Complete the agreement workflow in one place
by generating review reports, protecting sensitive information through Smart Redaction, and finalizing agreements with integrated Digital Signature and Request eSign capabilities.

By bringing every stage of agreement management into a single intelligent workflow, Wondershare PDFelement helps organizations and professionals review, negotiate, and finalize contracts with greater confidence, efficiency, and control.

"AI becomes more useful when it helps people move beyond understanding a document to completing the work around it," said Kim Huang, Head of Product for Wondershare PDFelement. "Wondershare PDFelement V13 marks another step in delivering on that vision. Looking ahead, we will continue developing AI experiences that support people across real-world creativity and productivity workflows, making it easier to move from ideas and information to action."
Availability
Wondershare PDFelement V13 is now available worldwide. To learn more about the latest release and explore its new intelligent workflow experiences, visit https://pdf.wondershare.com/.
About Wondershare

Wondershare is a globally recognized software company founded in 2003, known for its innovative solutions in creativity and productivity. Driven by the mission "Creativity Simplified", Wondershare offers a range of tools, including PDFelement for document management; EdrawMax, EdrawMind for diagram creativity, Filmora and SelfyzAI for video editing. With over 2 billion cumulative active users across all products and a presence in over 200 countries and regions, Wondershare empowers the next generation of creators with intuitive software and trendy creative resources, continually expanding the possibilities of creativity worldwide.
